message.content: Xavier Becerra is the stronger candidate for California governor. On Gaza, he called for a ceasefire, hostage release, and a two-state solution in May 2024, and in 2026 criticized Netanyahu's conduct while demanding international accountability, though he has not called Israel's actions in Gaza a genocide. His platform targets affordable healthcare, housing, and cost-of-living relief. He is endorsed by CAIR Action and Muslim Democrats of Southern California. Steve Hilton told JNS in May 2026 that California Democratic candidates ignore Jew-hatred, reframing the conflict as an intra-party anti-Semitism issue, and Vote for Peace documents that he supports U.S.-funded military aid to Israel and pledged legal action against California cities pursuing BDS, rating him Opposed for the general. Becerra, rated Neutral by the same guide, carries pro-Palestine-aligned endorsements, while Hilton holds an Israel-aligned recommendation from the San Mateo County Republican Party. On opposing the war in Gaza and resisting U.S. military and economic aid to Israel, Becerra has not crossed into calling the conduct a genocide, but Hilton actively endorses that aid, distinguishing the two on this race's central question.
